GMW.Prep.ButtonTooltip: Pre-session briefing: where you left off, open threads, who's ahead, what to pull from the book → journal
GMW.Prep.Title: Prep — pre-session briefing
GMW.Prep.Intro: One page built from the latest recaps, your notes and the book. Usually 1–2 minutes.
GMW.Prep.NotesHint: What you plan, where to nudge the party, who to bring on stage. Optional, but helps a lot.
GMW.Prep.Summaries: How many recent recaps to use
GMW.Prep.UseScene: Use the active scene (its pages and map notes)
GMW.Prep.NoSummaries: No recaps in the diary yet: the briefing will rely on your notes and the first chapter.
GMW.Prep.Done: Briefing ready and saved to the journal
GMW.Prep.Footer: GM Whispers draft based on {n} recaps. Review before the game.
GMW.Bible.Name: GM Whispers · Campaign Bible
GMW.Bible.Button: Campaign bible: a digest of the party, NPCs, factions and current state that the model gets with every question. Shift+click — rebuild from scratch
GMW.Bible.Title: Build the Campaign Bible
GMW.Bible.Intro: The first version is built from character backstories, the party, session recaps and the knowledge base. Afterwards you edit “Permanent”, and “Current state” is refreshed after every recap.
GMW.Bible.Done: Bible built. Open it and review “Permanent” — the module never touches that part.
GMW.Bible.Updated: Bible: “Current state” refreshed from the recap
GMW.Bible.Suggestions: suggestions for “Permanent” at the end — take a look
GMW.Bible.PermanentNote: This page is yours. The module never changes it. Put here what is always true: the party, key NPCs, table rules.
GMW.Bible.CurrentNote: The module rewrites this page after every recap. Move anything you want to keep for good to “Permanent”.
GMW.Examples.general.1: What could the party find in this location?
GMW.Examples.general.2: Which factions are active nearby and how will they treat the party?
GMW.Examples.general.3: Which special campaign rules could come into play here?
GMW.Examples.general.4: What rumours could the party have heard in the tavern lately?
GMW.Examples.general.5: What happened last session and which threads are still open?
GMW.Examples.general.6: Which hook can lead into the next chapter if the party stalls?
GMW.Examples.general.7: What consequences follow the party's decision from last time?
GMW.Examples.general.8: What reward fits this quest according to the book?
GMW.Examples.general.9: Which random encounters suit this part of the journey?
GMW.Examples.general.10: What do people here know about the party and how do they feel about it?
GMW.Examples.combat.1: How can the enemies use the terrain in this fight?
GMW.Examples.combat.2: Which enemies should retreat or surrender, and when?
GMW.Examples.combat.3: What happens if the fight drags on — who comes to the noise?
GMW.Examples.combat.4: How do cover and grappling work by the rules in this situation?
GMW.Examples.token.1: What does “{name}” know about the party and what is he hiding?
GMW.Examples.token.2: How will “{name}” react if the party asks for help?
GMW.Examples.token.3: What can “{name}” offer the party in return?
GMW.Examples.scene.1: Describe this scene to the players: what they see, hear and feel.
GMW.Examples.scene.2: Which secrets and hooks are hidden in this location in the book?
